summary: Describes the Mailbox Update (MUPDATE) protocol, which lets a group of IMAP or POP servers share a distributed mailbox database. This allows many machines to share the work of mail delivery instead of depending on a single machine. It is experimental.

eli5.summary: One mail room can get overloaded or break. This lets many mail rooms share one up-to-date list of who lives where, so mail still gets delivered if one room stops.
